{
  "task": "Manage email and multi-channel communication campaigns",
  "benefits": [
    "Integrate email functionality with existing applications and workflows",
    "Monitor email deliverability and identify spam issues",
    "Create and customize email templates for consistent communication",
    "Coordinate email, SMS, and WhatsApp from a single platform"
  ],
  "frictions": [
    "Customization of templates can be time-consuming for precise control",
    "Reporting and analytics lack granularity and ease of comparison across campaigns",
    "Tracking scheduling details and making last-minute changes across multiple emails is cumbersome",
    "Lack of a unified overview for comparing scheduling and performance across channels"
  ]
}
